top_signals.title: Japan Backs Overseas Oil Pipelines to Reduce Hormuz Dependence
top_signals.summary: Japan is planning to join the rush to diversify oil export routes away from the Strait of Hormuz by investing in pipeline projects abroad, notably in the Middle East. Citing a document produced by the country’s economy ministry, Bloomberg reported the investment will be made through Japanese companies in the form of risk-capital funding. Earlier this year, media reported that Saudi Arabia and the UAE had asked Japan to take part in the expansion of oil pipeline networks in the Middle East amid the rush to shift flows away from the Strait…

top_signals.title: Tata Power Targets 2032 for India's First Private Nuclear Plant
top_signals.summary: Tata Power, one of India’s biggest integrated power utilities, plans to build its first nuclear power plant by 2032 as the country opens the civil nuclear sector to private companies, CEO Praveer Sinha told Bloomberg Television in an interview on Tuesday. “What we can expect is that early part of 2028 we will start possibly the construction activity,” Sinha told Bloomberg. “We are targeting that 2032-2033, we will have the first of the nuclear plants ready in the private sector,” the executive added.
